BiblicalUsage: Ezrah is a Judahite, named in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 4:17 as the father of Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. The King James spells his name Ezra in that verse, but he is not Ezra the scribe — he belongs to an older generation of Judah, and his sons are listed among the families of the tribe. His name survives in a single verse of a long genealogy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the fathers of families even when they never stand on a stage. Ezrah did nothing famous, yet his four sons are named, and I hold that faithfulness inside a family is worth recording.
